text: Rail trails in BC and Alberta: facts and closures from BC Parks, the RDOS, Visit Penticton, Trails BC, the Province, the CVRD, the CRD, Travel Alberta and Travel Lakeland for the Kettle Valley Rail Trail (with Myra Canyon), the Columbia & Western, the Cowichan Valley Trail, the Galloping Goose and Lochside, and the Iron Horse Trail.
